better-borg-c.role: The C game and Borg source the bridge attaches to: better-borg-c milestone 8, which carries 88 fixes (patches/series.json). The zoo's newest bbc specimen is 4.2.6-bbc-m7, so there are no zoo results for this build to pair with yet; see PLAN.md T08.

original.role: The original C Borg (angband/angband e473720), the zoo's 4.2.6. Phase 2 reads it; the bridge may be checked against it.

runner.role: The zoo's runner: how a pinned source tree is instrumented, built headless and played. The bridge follows its pattern.

borg-zoo.role: Outcome vocabulary, run-record provenance and the play hash that this repository's records follow (docs/DESIGN.md).

borg-spec.role: The Borg specification and the Tunable Borg Plan: what the remake is meant to be. A source for the playing agent (docs/SOURCES.md, decision D8) and for phases 2 and 3.

borg-rs.role: The Rust Borg this repository's knowledge is for - the "Borg reborn". Pinned at the commit that carries better-borg-c milestone 7 (impact v7); the owner is building milestone 8 as this is written, so expect to move this pin and say so in the handover. Nothing reads it yet: it is here so a claim can cite a fixed version (decision D8), and because borg-rs/src/borg.rs holds the same inkey_hack connection the bridge attaches to on the C side. A claim says which side of the port it is about, because the two are not always on the same milestone.

c-borg-reference.role: The c-borg-reference branch of neo-angband-tracker: angband/angband e473720 (the original pin) plus three documentation commits, with lib/gamedata byte-identical to the better-borg-c and original pins. Two of its documents are sources for the playing agent, at the owner's request (2026-11-09): docs/strategy/, a strategy manual whose six appendices (monsters, uniques, monster spells, artifacts, ego items, objects) are generated from lib/gamedata by docs/strategy/tools/gen_appendices.py and whose README links to eight chapters that are not in the tree; and docs/user-manual.md, a single-file manual of the whole game (about 3,700 lines) whose tables were extracted from lib/gamedata. Both were written by a model on 2026-11-09. They are not the game's manual: a claim read in them is static:strategy-manual or static:user-manual, never documented.

sources.note: What the playing agent may read beyond the manual (decision D8, 2026-11-08). Each entry names the pin it is read at, so a claim can cite a fixed commit.

issues.unpinned: The open issues of diegoami/better-borg-c, diegoami/borg-zoo and diegoami/neo-angband-tracker. A claim records the issue number and the date it was read, since a tracker moves.

manual_online.unpinned: https://angband.readthedocs.io/en/latest/command.html, at the owner's request (2026-11-09). It is the upstream rendering of docs/command.rst from angband/angband's master, which stood at e473720 (the original pin) on 2026-11-09; that file is byte-identical at the better-borg-c pin (blob fb6993d5). 'latest' moves with upstream, so a claim cites docs/command.rst at a pin, not the URL.
